"""Second-order semantic edge cases from the specification."""
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from harness import Checks, prof, query, rec

c = Checks()
KEYS = {'query', 'profile', 'rcode', 'termination', 'final_name', 'answer', 'trace'}

def full(name, doc, runs, audits=None, diag=None):
    rc, out, err = None, None, None
    import subprocess
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    rc, out, err = p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr
    ok = rc == 0 and out.endswith(b'\n') and not err
    if not ok:
        c.check(name, False, 'rc=%r err=%r out=%r' % (rc, err[:200], out[:120]))
        return None
    got = json.loads(out)
    if got['runs'] != runs:
        c.check(name, False, 'runs mismatch:\n got  %s\n want %s'
                % (json.dumps(got['runs'], indent=1), json.dumps(runs, indent=1)))
        return None
    if audits is not None and got['audits'] != audits:
        c.check(name, False, 'audits %s vs %s' % (got['audits'], audits))
        return None
    if diag is not None:
        d = got['diagnostic']
        if (d['equivalence'], d['cost'], d['count']) != (diag['equivalence'], diag['cost'], diag['count']):
            c.check(name, False, 'diagnostic %s' % d)
            return None
    for run in got['runs']:
        if set(run) != KEYS:
            c.check(name + ' keys', False, set(run))
            return None
    c.check(name, True)
    return got

def R(q, p, rcode, term, final, answer, trace):
    return {'query': q, 'profile': p, 'rcode': rcode, 'termination': term,
            'final_name': final,
            'answer': [{'owner': o, 'type': t, 'data': d} for o, t, d in answer],
            'trace': trace}

# D: a loop that leaves one zone and returns; LOOP precedes authority
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'b.example.')]},
                 {'origin': 'example.', 'records': [rec('b.example.', 'CNAME', 'a.test.')]}],
       'profiles': [prof('pl', 9)], 'queries': [query('qa', 'a.test.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': []}
full('D loop across zones beats authority', doc, [
    R('qa', 'pl', 'SERVFAIL', 'LOOP', 'a.test.',
      [('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'b.example.'), ('b.example.', 'CNAME', 'a.test.')],
      ['a.test.', 'b.example.', 'a.test.'])])

# E: budget exhaustion before an external hop; and external after the last hop
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'b.test.'),
                                                 rec('b.test.', 'CNAME', 'x.example.'),
                                                 rec('c.test.', 'CNAME', 'd.test.'),
                                                 rec('d.test.', 'CNAME', 'x.example.')]}],
       'profiles': [prof('m0', 0), prof('m1', 1)], 'queries': [query('qa', 'a.test.', 'A', 1),
                                                               query('qc', 'c.test.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': []}
full('E budget versus external authority', doc, [
    # qa: m0 -> LIMIT immediately at a.test. (pending CNAME not appended)
    R('qa', 'm0', 'SERVFAIL', 'LIMIT', 'a.test.', [], ['a.test.']),
    # qa: m1 -> follows to b.test. (count=1), b.test. has a CNAME but count==max -> LIMIT
    R('qa', 'm1', 'SERVFAIL', 'LIMIT', 'b.test.',
      [('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'b.test.')], ['a.test.', 'b.test.']),
    # qc: m0 -> LIMIT at c.test.
    R('qc', 'm0', 'SERVFAIL', 'LIMIT', 'c.test.', [], ['c.test.']),
    # qc: m1 -> one alias to d.test. (count=1), d.test. has a CNAME but the budget is
    # spent -> LIMIT happens before following into the external name
    R('qc', 'm1', 'SERVFAIL', 'LIMIT', 'd.test.',
      [('c.test.', 'CNAME', 'd.test.')], ['c.test.', 'd.test.'])])

# E2: exactly reaching the external name with the last allowed alias
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'x.example.')]}],
       'profiles': [prof('m1', 1)], 'queries': [query('qa', 'a.test.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': []}
full('E2 external after the final alias', doc, [
    R('qa', 'm1', 'NOERROR', 'EXTERNAL', 'x.example.',
      [('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'x.example.')], ['a.test.', 'x.example.'])])

# I: a CNAME-typed query with cname=stop still answers directly
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'b.test.'),
                                                rec('b.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')]}],
       'profiles': [prof('stop', 4, 'stop')], 'queries': [query('qa', 'a.test.', 'CNAME', 1),
                                                          query('qb', 'b.test.', 'CNAME', 1)],
       'observations': []}
full('I cname query under stop policy', doc, [
    R('qa', 'stop', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'a.test.', [('a.test.', 'CNAME', 'b.test.')], ['a.test.']),
    R('qb', 'stop', 'NOERROR', 'NODATA', 'b.test.', [], ['b.test.'])])

# M: the query name itself is the (absent) wildcard candidate
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')]}],
       'profiles': [prof('pr', 4)], 'queries': [query('qstar', '*.test.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': []}
full('M query name equals absent wildcard', doc, [
    R('qstar', 'pr', 'NXDOMAIN', 'NXDOMAIN', '*.test.', [], ['*.test.'])])

# N: an empty more specific zone shadows the root zone entirely
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': [rec('*.', 'A', '192.0.2.1'),
                                            rec('a.', 'A', '192.0.2.2')]},
                 {'origin': 'test.', 'records': []}],
       'profiles': [prof('pr', 4)], 'queries': [query('qx', 'x.test.', 'A', 1),
                                                query('qa', 'a.', 'A', 1),
                                                query('qb', 'b.zzz.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': []}
full('N empty specific zone shadows root', doc, [
    # x.test. selects the empty test. zone: NXDOMAIN, even though *. exists in the root zone
    R('qx', 'pr', 'NXDOMAIN', 'NXDOMAIN', 'x.test.', [], ['x.test.']),
    R('qa', 'pr', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'a.', [('a.', 'A', '192.0.2.2')], ['a.']),
    R('qb', 'pr', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'b.zzz.', [('b.zzz.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')], ['b.zzz.'])])

# N2: same but with wildcard records at a zone that does exist below the root
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': '.', 'records': [rec('*.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')]},
                 {'origin': 'sub.test.', 'records': [rec('*.sub.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.3')]}],
       'profiles': [prof('pr', 4)], 'queries': [query('qn', 'w.sub.test.', 'A', 1),
                                                query('qz', 'w.test.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': []}
full('N2 wildcard inside the matching zone only', doc, [
    R('qn', 'pr', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'w.sub.test.',
      [('w.sub.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.3')], ['w.sub.test.']),
    # no zone for test. other than the root: synthesis from *. at the root zone
    R('qz', 'pr', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'w.test.', [('w.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')], ['w.test.'])])

# O: a zone whose origin itself is a wildcard name
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': '*.test.', 'records': [rec('a.*.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.4'),
                                                  rec('*.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.5')]}],
       'profiles': [prof('pr', 4)],
       'queries': [query('q1', 'a.*.test.', 'A', 1), query('q2', 'x.*.test.', 'A', 1),
                  query('q3', 'x.test.', 'A', 1), query('q4', 'b.*.test.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': []}
full('O wildcard origin zone', doc, [
    R('q1', 'pr', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'a.*.test.', [('a.*.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.4')], ['a.*.test.']),
    # x.*.test. does not exist; closest encloser is *.test. which does exist (as an owner)
    R('q2', 'pr', 'NOERROR', 'NODATA', 'x.*.test.', [], ['x.*.test.']),
    # x.test. is not below *.test. at all -> outside every zone
    R('q3', 'pr', 'REFUSED', 'OUTSIDE', 'x.test.', [], ['x.test.']),
    # b.*.test. -> encloser *.test., candidate *.*.test. absent -> NXDOMAIN
    R('q4', 'pr', 'NXDOMAIN', 'NXDOMAIN', 'b.*.test.', [], ['b.*.test.'])])

# L: TXT payloads with JSON-significant characters survive exactly
weird = 'quote " backslash \\ brace } end'
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('a.test.', 'TXT', weird)]}],
       'profiles': [prof('pr', 4)], 'queries': [query('qa', 'a.test.', 'TXT', 1)],
       'observations': [{'id': 'o1', 'query': 'qa', 'profile': 'pr',
                         'result': {'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NOERROR',
                                    'answer': [rec('a.test.', 'TXT', weird)]}}]}
full('L TXT payload with JSON characters', doc, [
    R('qa', 'pr', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'a.test.', [('a.test.', 'TXT', weird)], ['a.test.'])],
    [{'id': 'o1', 'verdict': 'match', 'different': []}])

# P: one-label mode against a wildcard one label below the closest encloser
doc = {'zones': [{'origin': 'test.', 'records': [rec('*.sub.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.1'),
                                                rec('w.sub.sub.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.2')]}],
       'profiles': [prof('rfc', 4), prof('one', 4, 'follow', 'one-label')],
       'queries': [query('q1', 'a.sub.test.', 'A', 1),
                  query('q2', 'a.b.sub.test.', 'A', 1),
                  query('q3', 'a.sub.sub.test.', 'A', 1)],
       'observations': []}
# existing: test., sub.test., *.sub.test., sub.sub.test., w.sub.sub.test.
full('P one-label versus rfc wildcard depth', doc, [
    # a.sub.test. -> encloser sub.test. (one more label) -> *.sub.test. exists
    R('q1', 'one', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'a.sub.test.', [('a.sub.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')], ['a.sub.test.']),
    R('q1', 'rfc', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'a.sub.test.', [('a.sub.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')], ['a.sub.test.']),
    # a.b.sub.test. -> closest encloser sub.test. (2 labels away): candidate *.sub.test.
    R('q2', 'one', 'NXDOMAIN', 'NXDOMAIN', 'a.b.sub.test.', [], ['a.b.sub.test.']),
    R('q2', 'rfc', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'a.b.sub.test.', [('a.b.sub.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.1')], ['a.b.sub.test.']),
    # a.sub.sub.test. -> not existing; closest encloser sub.sub.test.; no *.sub.sub.test.
    R('q3', 'one', 'NXDOMAIN', 'NXDOMAIN', 'a.sub.sub.test.', [], ['a.sub.sub.test.']),
    R('q3', 'rfc', 'NXDOMAIN', 'NXDOMAIN', 'a.sub.sub.test.', [], ['a.sub.sub.test.'])],
